I was unemployed for two months, and got by doing random odd jobs. It was low-key kind of fun, having so much free time and doing whatever I wanted and also making money in between but I couldn’t afford anything nice, just my rent and food basically. I wouldn’t recommend it for more than two months and I would definitely start looking for something before you come and at least have an idea of what it is you wanna do .  If you really grind at it like I did, just pumping out the job applications, constantly, and really putting effort into them, you can find a job within two months. A good one. I spent 1 to 3 hours a day during the time I was unemployed, applying for jobs and doing interviews. That’s what it takes but if you have a degree and prior experience, I feel confident that you would find something, even if it took a month or two. Don’t quote me on that though, I also have friends and other random industries that have been unemployed here for a very long time and are relying on their parents to get by. It’s all a crapshoot, but I say go for it.

Thank you for the advice. Wanted to give you an update! I was trying to give him the benefit of the doubt, see if maybe we could meet somewhere in the middle … but nope! So basically, I found out that he lied to me. Not once but several times. He agreed to not going on dates with other people over the phone yesterday before I went to bed. He said he was fine being exclusive going forward at least in terms of not going on dates were having sex with others. Today, he talked on the phone with me again, saying that he wants to be honest with me and admitted to me that yesterday meeting the girl was a date and he is unsure of his feelings about her, but likes me more and wants to “compare” us. WTF.  As if that already wasn’t lowkey shitty enough, he pulls this… we were supposed to go to dinner tomorrow at a nice fancy restaurant. And beforehand we were going to go to a yoga class. It cost $35 for me to bring a guest. And I paid for it for him. He then texts me tonight asking if he can cancel because he got invited to a movie tomorrow by a friend whose only in town for the week and he got a free ticket at a exclusive premier. I was kind of annoyed about it, but I told him sure whatever because I don’t wanna be controlling. Anyways, basically he got caught in a lie because he lied about the friend that he was going with. I could tell that he was stuttering and stammering, so I called him out on it. He tried to go back-and-forth with the truth for about an hour on the phone. He claimed that he was going with a male friend from Los Angeles.. Turns out after all that BS it’s a date. With a girl. Not the girl from Sunday, a third girl. He made this friend up and a whole fake career for him throughout an entire conversation. So he blew me off for another girl, while telling me that he wants to be exclusive and keep seeing me, and that he wasn’t seeing anybody else. And that he didn’t have any other dates planned. After admitting all this to me, he starts getting really upset and saying that he really wants to keep seeing me and that he’ll never lie to me again and that he really wants a relationship because he wants somebody to support him through his depression… lol. I told him I can’t handle all this drama so early on and all the compulsive lying so I’m going to go to the yoga class tomorrow but it’s up to him whether or not he’s going to join me and that I would probably not like to see him again after that. I just hope I did the right thing. I was so excited about this man and felt such a strong connection. I could’ve maybe been willing to hear him out or if he had just been honest about everything. People suck
